# ctables/var

> Variable read: the variable's storage.

truck [ctables](../ctables.md) · [source](../../../registry/ctables/var.pkg)

  The `addr` section gives its address, for `&x`.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm
{addr}
```

### `emit addr`

```nasm
((W)&{addr})
```
